I run projectcostestimator.com, an independent website cost calculator (we don't build sites). Two things for CdM, since your site says "Uvijek provjerene informacije, sa vama od 1997. godine":

1. The calculator on your own site. The visitor prices their project on your page and the button sends them to your contact form; your name on it, your colours, no credit line, loads and clicks counted per day. Embed Pro is $29 a month for one domain, cancel any time.

2. A free listing here. People who finish an estimate can ask for quotes, and the request, with type, platform, budget band and deadline already filled in, goes to listed web design agencies that serve the UK. No commission, no contract, nothing billed for requests right now.

Both start from one two-minute form: https://projectcostestimator.com/for-agencies?ref=out-cdm

If it's not for you, reply "no" and I won't write again, or use this link and the system
stops on its own: https://projectcostestimator.com/api/unsubscribe?e=redakcija%40cdm.me&s=c66f692156918fe8fd5cbf5233223316

Florin Florea
founder, Project Cost Estimator
hello@projectcostestimator.com
